pr_title: 🐛 Fix "The request content was malformed" error in home_connect

issue_context.title: Home Connect: start_program fails with malformed request exception
issue_context.body:
### The problem

**Issue**: When trying to start a program for my oven, the request fails with an "Unknown error". The error response from home connect states that "The request content was malformed".

```
homeconnect.api.HomeConnectError: {'description': 'The request content was malformed:\nExpected Collection as JsArray, but got {"key":"Cooking.Oven.Option.SetpointTemperature","unit":"°C","value":230}', 'key': '400'}
```

As stated in the response, and what I can see in the Home Connect API documentation, the actual *options* value needs to be an array of objects instead of the object itself.

* Current value to Home Connect
   ```
   {"key":"Cooking.Oven.Option.SetpointTemperature","unit":"°C","value":230}
   ```
* Expected value to Home Connect
   ```
   [
       {"key":"Cooking.Oven.Option.SetpointTemperature","unit":"°C","value":230},
   ]
   ```

**Solution**:

1. Provide a plain "options" key for writing custom options JSON
2. Provide a UI to define multiple options

**Related**:

* Home connect API documentation: https://api-docs.home-connect.com/programs-and-options#oven
* Start program options in the Home Assistant code: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/cd03c49fc27d3b2c8c33ad032a9207acdd71b9ca/homeassistant/components/home_connect/__init__.py#L143

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.07.2

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

_No response_

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/home_connect/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
service: home_connect.start_program
data:
  device_id: ...
  program: Cooking.Oven.Program.HeatingMode.HotAir
  key: Cooking.Oven.Option.SetpointTemperature
  value: 230
  unit: °C
```
```

review_comments: The option key is required in the service schema. Please use `dict[key]` to access required dict keys.
No it is not. The `SERVICE_PROGRAM_SCHEMA` consists of two sets. One contains the `ATTR_KEY`, the other does not.
It would be if it were required, but [it is not](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/76411#discussion_r945327456).
We only ever append a single item to this list. We could just create the list with this item directly. We don't need to append the item.

Is there a big difference between appending and overwriting? An empty list of options should still be the fallback if `option_key` is not set. I thought reusing the existing list would be more efficient.
This code makes sense now that I see that option_key is optional.
